params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Qiyana}} {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} deal {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}.
params.blurb2: This effect cannot occur on the same target for a period of time. Gathering an {{as|Element|buzzword}} with ''{{ai|Terrashape|Qiyana}}'' will {{sti|cdr|reset}} the cooldown.
params.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Qiyana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} deal {{pp|15 + (83-15)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 25% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}.

This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
params.description2: Gathering an {{as|Element|buzzword}} with ''{{ai|Terrashape|Qiyana}}'' resets ''Royal Privilege's'' per-target {{sti|cooldown}} for enemies affected by ''Royal Privilege'' using a different {{as|Element|buzzword}} (or no {{as|Element|buzzword}}).
params.notes:
* ''Royal Privilege's'' trigger from a basic attack can be {{tip|blocked}} (additional damage is negated and the on-target cooldown does not apply).
* ''Royal Privilege'' will not apply a cooldown to targets that are hit with an {{ai|Elemental Wrath|Qiyana}} that has a different {{ai|Terrashape|Qiyana|Element}} than the {{ai|Terrashape|Qiyana|Element}} '''Qiyana''' currently holds.
** This does not occur if a new {{ai|Elemental Wrath|Qiyana}} with a different {{ai|Terrashape|Qiyana|Element}} is cast before the first one lands.
* The effect will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.
* {{Pending for test}}: ''Royal Privilege's'' interaction with ''parrying'' effects ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|blind}}).
* ''Royal Privilege'' is applied in a separate damage instance from '''Qiyana's''' basic attacks and abilities.
** This causes effects like {{ri|Bone Plating}} and {{iis|Black Cleaver}} {{nie|Carve}} to be applied twice.{{bug|2}}

blurb.plain:
Active: Qiyana hurls her blade in the target direction that blasts in a line upon hitting an enemy or max range, dealing physical damage, reduced against enemies beyond the closest. This consumes the current Element to empower the blade with an additional effect.
* Brush: The blade creates a grass field around Qiyana that lasts a short time, granting her invisibility and bonus movement speed until she attacks or exits the field.
* River: The blast briefly roots enemies hit, then briefly slows them.
* Terrain: The blast deals bonus damage against enemies below half health.

description.plain: Active: Qiyana hurls her blade in the target direction that blasts in a line upon hitting an enemy or maximum range, consuming the current Element to empower the blade with an additional effect.

description2.plain: Enemies hit are dealt Edge of Ixtal's damage, reduced to 75% against subsequent enemies beyond the closest. Elemental Wrath deals 160% damage against monsters.

description3.plain: Brush: The blade creates a grass field around Qiyana that lasts for up to 3 seconds, granting her invisibility and 20% bonus movement speed until she attacks, casts an ability other than Terrashape, or exits the field.

description4.plain: River: The blast roots enemies hit for 0.5 seconds, then slows them by 20% for 1 second.

description5.plain: Terrain: The blast deals 60% increased damage against enemies below 50% of their maximum health. Subsequent targets beyond the closest that are below the threshold take 35% increased damage instead.

variants.label: Hurl missile and explosion missile width

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} While holding an {{as|Element|buzzword}}, {{ci|Qiyana}} gains '''bonus''' {{sti|as|{{as|attack speed}}}} and {{sti|range|attack range}}, as well as {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} on her basic attacks and basic abilities. '''Qiyana''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} speed while moving near the current {{as|Element|buzzword}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Qiyana''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction to gather the {{as|Element|buzzword}} of the nearest {{cci|Terrashape Brush.png}} {{sbc|{{as|Brush}}}}, {{cci|Terrashape River.png}} {{sbc|{{as|River}}}} or {{cci|Terrashape Rock.png}} {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}} she targeted.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While holding an {{as|Element|buzzword}}, '''Qiyana''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' attack range}} and {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} on her basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} and basic abilities. While [[Combat status|out-of-combat]] and moving near the {{as|Element|buzzword}} currently being held, she gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Qiyana''' {{tip|dashes}} up to 300 units towards the target location to gather the {{as|Element|buzzword}} of the nearest {{cci|Terrashape Brush.png}} {{sbc|{{as|Brush}}}}, {{cci|Terrashape River.png}} {{sbc|{{as|River}}}} or {{cci|Terrashape Rock.png}} {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}} she targeted.
params.description3: ''A target Element is required to cast this ability''.
params.description4: Once ''Terrashape'' has been learned, '''Qiyana''' is automatically given the {{cci|Terrashape Rock.png}} {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}} element upon [[Death|respawning]].
params.description5: '''''Qiyana''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash.''
params.notes:
* ''Terrashape'' has no minimum dash range.
* ''Terrashape'' does not interact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
* The water puddles formed by the {{ui|Ocean Drake|Ocean Rift}} on {{tip|Summoner's Rift}} count as valid terrain for obtaining the {{cci|Terrashape River.png}} {{sbc|{{as|River}}}} element.
* The {{tip|brush|brushes}} grown by {{cai|Brushmaker|Ivern}} count for gathering the {{cci|Terrashape Brush.png}} {{sbc|{{as|Brush}}}} element.
* Passive bonus damage from basic attacks can be {{tip|blocked}}.
* {{Pending for test}}: Passive bonus damage interaction with ''parrying'' effects ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|blind}}).

blurb.plain: Passive: While holding an Element, Qiyana gains bonus attack speed and attack range, as well as bonus magic damage on her basic attacks and basic abilities. Qiyana gains bonus movement speed speed while moving near the current Element.

blurb2.plain: Active: Qiyana dashes in the target direction to gather the Element of the nearest ⟦cci⟧ Brush, ⟦cci⟧ River or ⟦cci⟧ Terrain she targeted.

description.plain: Passive: While holding an Element, Qiyana gains bonus attack speed, 25 bonus attack range and bonus magic damage on her basic attacks on-hit and basic abilities. While out-of-combat and moving near the Element currently being held, she gains bonus movement speed.

description2.plain: Active: Qiyana dashes up to 300 units towards the target location to gather the Element of the nearest ⟦cci⟧ Brush, ⟦cci⟧ River or ⟦cci⟧ Terrain she targeted.

description3.plain: A target Element is required to cast this ability.

description4.plain: Once Terrashape has been learned, Qiyana is automatically given the ⟦cci⟧ Terrain element upon respawning.

description5.plain: Qiyana can cast any of her abilities during the dash.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Qiyana}} {{tip|dash|dashes}} toward the target enemy and deals {{as|physical damage}} upon arrival.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Qiyana''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy. If they are in range upon arrival, she deals {{as|physical damage}}.
params.description2: '''''Qiyana''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash.''
params.notes:
* ''Audacity'' only damages targets if within 250 range upon completion of the dash.
* '''Qiyana''' will automatically be ordered to [[Basic attack#Acquisition|acquire]] and attack ''Audacity's'' target as soon as the dash completes.

blurb.plain: Active: Qiyana dashes toward the target enemy and deals physical damage upon arrival.

description.plain: Active: Qiyana dashes a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy. If they are in range upon arrival, she deals physical damage.

description2.plain: Qiyana can cast any of her abilities during the dash.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Qiyana}} sweeps a windblast in the target direction that {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} enemies hit and stops upon hitting {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}}.
params.blurb2: The windblast creates a cascading shockwave across any {{sbc|{{as|River}}}} or {{sbc|{{as|Brush}}}} it passes, as well as around the borders of {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}} it hits. The shockwave briefly {{tip|stun|stuns}} enemies hit and deals {{as|physical damage}} based on {{as|their '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Qiyana''' sweeps a windblast in the target direction that {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} enemies hit by {{tt|375 units|estimated}}, though not through terrain, and stops upon hitting {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}}.
params.description2: The windblast creates a cascading shockwave across any {{sbc|{{as|River}}}} or {{sbc|{{as|Brush}}}} it passes through, as well as around the borders of {{sbc|{{as|Terrain}}}} it reaches, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{pp|changedisplay=true|type=proximity|0.5;1|0;X}} seconds, and briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of the area along its path. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|100 to 300 3}} {{as|(+ 125% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 10% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Capped Monster Health Damage|{{ap|500 to 1000 3}} {{as|(+ 125% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
params.notes:
* The windblast needs only to reach near terrain to trigger the terrain shockwave.
* The shockwave grants sight along each part of its path for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
* Artificial terrain (e.g, {{cai|Crystallize|Anivia}}, {{cai|Weaver's Wall|Taliyah}}, {{cai|Pillar of Ice|Trundle}}) touching map terrain will be treated as a single piece of terrain, even when bridging two pieces of map terrain together; the shockwave will wrap around all connecting terrain. The shockwave's path is determined once it initially spreads; any expired terrain will be treated as if it were still there.
* {{tip|Projectile|Projectile-intercepting}} effects will block the windblast but not the shockwave.
{{Effect at cast time end}}

blurb.plain: Active: Qiyana sweeps a windblast in the target direction that knocks back enemies hit and stops upon hitting Terrain.

blurb2.plain: The windblast creates a cascading shockwave across any River or Brush it passes, as well as around the borders of Terrain it hits. The shockwave briefly stuns enemies hit and deals physical damage based on their maximum health.

description.plain: Active: Qiyana sweeps a windblast in the target direction that knocks back enemies hit by 375 units, though not through terrain, and stops upon hitting Terrain.

description2.plain: The windblast creates a cascading shockwave across any River or Brush it passes through, as well as around the borders of Terrain it reaches, dealing physical damage to enemies hit, stunning them for 0.5 – 1 (based on proximity) seconds, and briefly granting sight of the area along its path. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped against monsters.
